name: tab-nav
title: Tab Nav
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: Navigation between the pages of an area that looks like tabs: a `<nav>` of react-aria links where the current page carries `aria-current="page"`. Unlike `Tabs` there are no panels — each item is a route — so use it for sub-pages and `Tabs` for in-page views. `variant` matches the tab styles: `default` (segmented on `muted`, the current page raised) or `line` (underlined). An item is current when `isCurrent` is set or its `href` matches `TabNav`'s `currentHref` (exactly, or with `matchPrefix` also on sub-paths). `TabNavItem` takes an icon before its label; `TabNavSeparator` divides groups. When items don't fit, the strip scrolls sideways and keeps the current page in view. Wrap the app in react-aria's `RouterProvider` for client routing.
